entities.name: Yi Sun-sin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Korean admiral (1545–1598) who is widely regarded as one of the greatest naval commanders in history. With his innovative turtle ships (geobukseon) and brilliant tactics, he won 23 consecutive naval engagements against the Japanese during the Imjin War (1592–1598), never losing a single battle despite being consistently outnumbered.
